analysis.one_line_summary: A creator demonstrates a thermal round brush by releasing a curled section to reveal a smooth, voluminous blowout result.
analysis.full_description: A vertical UGC video featuring a young blonde woman styling her hair with a pink thermal round brush (Wavytalk Blowout Boost). At the start, the brush is wrapped around the ends of a front strand of hair with the on-screen text 'POV: you're terrible at doing your hair but found this tool'. She twists and pulls the brush down, releasing a polished inward curled blowout. She sets the tool down and shakes out and touches her voluminous, smooth blonde layers while smiling at the camera.

on_screen_text.text: POV: you're terrible at doing your hair but found this tool

scenes.visual: Young blonde woman looking directly into the camera holding a pink thermal round brush wrapped around the ends of her hair.
scenes.action: She gently rotates and slides the heated round brush out of the bottom section of her hair.

scenes.visual: The woman looks at the camera showing off her layered blowout.
scenes.action: She sets the tool down, runs her hands through her freshly styled voluminous curls, adjusts her hair, and smiles confidently.
